title: SIMULATED Type 2 Diabetes Lifestyle Study
brief_summary: Synthetic classroom study of adults with type 2 diabetes taking metformin. Not a real recruiting trial.
eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Type 2 diabetes
* Metformin treatment
* HbA1c above 7 percent
Exclusion Criteria:
* Kidney disease

title: SIMULATED Hypertension Monitoring Study

eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Hypertension
* Blood pressure measurement
Exclusion Criteria:
* History of stroke
